methodology.unitOfAnalysis: request/allocation pair; the same physical allocation may occur in several harmonic requests/contexts
methodology.statusSource: Unmodified default production createPhysicalScreen.metrics; original status retained on every instrument projection
methodology.instrumentProjection: Same structural allocations; geometry only; no verdict computation under reference instruments
methodology.quantiles: Nearest-rank quantile lies in reported [lower,upper) mm bin; fixed 1-mm bins; not exact quantile values. Exact minimum, maximum, mean and population SD are streaming floating-point moments.
methodology.histogramFormat: Pairs [inclusiveLowerMm,count]; all bins width1mm. Quantile upper endpoint exclusive.
methodology.contactHistograms: Exact integer counts. omitted means unplayed strings, not missing harmonic tones.
methodology.correlations: Pearson descriptive correlations over dependent request/allocation pairs; no human labels, significance tests or prediction claim
methodology.slices: Quality, context, quality/context, maximum stopped fret and broad maximum-stopped-position; geometry for primary GS Mini only
methodology.representativePairs: Post-scan extrema selected for illustration within identical status, group count, exact min/max stopped frets, stopped count and open count; not a held-out validation set
methodology.optimalPartitionCount: Counts minimal ordered disjoint compatible interval partitions, not anatomical fingerings or overlapping covers
